retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, low-angle urban scene featuring a central figure in a straitjacket within a dark, textured asylum setting, utilizing high-contrast orange and blue lighting.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure is depicted upside down or in a contorted position wearing a tan straitjacket, set against a dark, decaying brick and concrete background. The lighting is harsh and directional, creating deep shadows and highlighting textures of peeling paint and grime. A secondary figure stands in the background shadows, adding to the psychological tension.
coreVisualRelationships: Contorted central subject vs. rigid vertical background architecture
Vibrant orange typography vs. cool blue-toned environmental shadows
Sharp foreground focus vs. atmospheric, dark background depth
Aggressive graffiti-style display type vs. clean serif secondary type
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Gritty, distressed surface textures on walls and floor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central figure dominates the mid-ground, positioned slightly off-center and contorted.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright tan color of the straitjacket acts as the primary visual anchor against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large orange title, moves down to the central face, then follows the light into the dark background shadows.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark, textured negative space in the bottom and side quadrants to emphasize isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and cool blue-grays for the environment and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tan and beige for the central subject's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vivid saturated orange for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the spotlighted subject and the surrounding darkness; high saturation contrast in the title.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary greens or pinks

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Aggressive, sharp-edged display type with graffiti influences.
letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke widths with heavy horizontal emphasis
Dripping paint effects or jagged extensions
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial and terminal letters feature elongated, sweeping flourishes
Internal letters are compressed and angular
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive custom lettering paired with a clean, spaced-out classical serif for legibility and contrast.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory style warning block in corner

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Chicano or Graffiti style custom lettering
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive urban tone of the display text.
Provides the necessary high-contrast serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty urban asylum cell from a low angle. A man in a tan straitjacket is the central focus, contorted or upside down. The walls are dark brick and concrete with peeling paint. Use a cool blue spotlight from above and deep shadows. Include a secondary figure standing in the dark background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, aggressive orange graffiti-style title at the top. Below it, add a clean, white, all-caps serif subtitle with wide tracking. Place a black and white rectangular advisory badge in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with a blue/orange balance?
Does the main title have sharp, jagged terminals?
Is the central figure wearing a tan straitjacket?
Is the background texture gritty and distressed?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange title is the most saturated element.
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Check that the straitjacket texture looks realistic and worn.
